title: Java field facts are not discoverable from code.items feedback
wanted_capability: When code.items omits Java field_declaration facts, the tool or docs should point callers to code.fields instead of making them infer the separate field surface.
fallback_used: Recipe now states that code.items does not surface Java field declarations and instructs probes to use code.fields.
notes: This is a discoverability/runbook gap rather than a missing fact surface; code.fields exists and works.
resolution_note: Addressed in blackbox beta/blackbox-v2 commit 02799bbc: the code.items tool description and the items() TS declaration now state that Java field declarations are not items and point at code.fields, so a zero-field items result is self-explaining at the surface an agent actually reads. The namespace-level pointer already existed (landed 2026-06-13 with the code.fields feature).
